findings.mechanism: decode_frame mallocs the pixel buffer (decoder.c:29) and on CRC mismatch returns FRAME_ERR_CHECKSUM without free(buf); the buffer is not handed to out, so no caller can free it. Every damaged frame leaks 4-32 KiB of malloc memory.
findings.cause: missing free(buf) on the checksum-failure early return (the payload-error path does free it)
findings.evidence: valgrind on 200 iterations: 178,176 bytes in 12 blocks definitely lost, allocated at decoder.c:29 (decode_frame). Max RSS: 2000 iterations 13.3 MB, 20000 iterations 23.2 MB with --damage-every 16, but 13.3 MB with --damage-every 0 at 20000 iterations, so growth tracks damaged frames only.

findings.mechanism: static raw[FRAME_MAX_DECODED] scratch buffer in synth_next, plus the static CRC table in checksum.c
findings.evidence: RSS stays flat (13.3 MB at 2000 and 20000 iterations) when no frames are damaged
findings.discriminator: Fixed size, reused on every call and does not scale with frame count; RSS is flat with --damage-every 0.
